title: Five gates between a document and a user

steps.title: 01 Datasource enabled
steps.body: The datasource must be enabled for search. A test datasource shows results only to beta users, who still need document permissions.

steps.title: 02 Document permissions
steps.body: Documents are either permission-aware, with ACLs pushed per document, or visible to everyone in the organization. You choose at setup.

steps.title: 03 Identities exist
steps.body: Users must be indexed before they are referenced. A group must be indexed before its memberships.

steps.title: 04 Processing finished
steps.body: Permissions and memberships are processed asynchronously.

steps.title: 05 Click-through
steps.body: Opening a result usually sends the user to the source, which may check access again.
